intent: Prevent concurrent connection attempts for an addrConn by retaining its mutex between validating or updating its state and starting the transport reset. Preserve address update, shutdown, and transport lifecycle behavior.
testing_gaps: The change adds no regression test that forces concurrent Connect calls or an address update during connection setup; the PR reports repeated execution of the existing AuthorityRevive test. Tests were not independently run.
